procedures.name: Northstar launch readiness review
steps: Every plan step cites a current approved decision, source or task by ID.
No step relies on a superseded decision; superseded decisions may only be mentioned as history.
Tasks that implement superseded decisions are identified with a proposed next action.
Uncertainties (missing owners, dates or evidence) are listed, not invented.
The plan proposes changes only; it never claims an action was completed or approved.

history.notes: Earlier conversation from before the scope change. Recorded as conversation and episodic memory (history, not current truth).

messages.content: Plan for Friday: we launch with payments enabled. Backend should finish the payment webhooks this week and web should publish the pricing page with checkout.
Noted. Launch plan: payments enabled Friday; task-01 payment webhooks (backend), task-02 pricing page with checkout (web, blocked by task-01).

episodes.summary: On 5 October the team planned a Friday launch with payments enabled: payment webhooks (task-01) and a pricing page with checkout (task-02).
